chunks: I have experienced in you three things and two others: deaf with ears, dumb with speech, and blind with sight,
neither true supporters in combat nor dependable brothers in distress!
Your hands may be soiled with earth. O examples of those camels whose herdsman has disappeared!
if they are collected together from one side they disperse from the other.
By Allāh, I see you in my imagination that if war becomes intense and action is in full swing you would run away from the son of Abī Ṭālib like the woman who becomes naked in the front.
I am certainly on clear guidance from my Lord (Allāh) and on the path of my Prophet and I am on the right path which I adhere to regularly.

key_terms.ابْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: Son of Abī Ṭālib (referring to Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What metaphors did Imam Ali use to describe the people of Kūfah's lack of loyalty?
ai.summary: In this famous admonition from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the people of Kūfah for their spiritual insensitivity—described as 'deaf with hearing, dumb with speech, and blind with sight'—which led to their fickleness during the Battle of Siffin. He contrasts their disunity, likened to scattered camels, with his own firm adherence to divine proof and the Prophet's methodology, highlighting the Shia scholarly emphasis on steadfastness amidst political turmoil.

en.sayed-ali-raza: I have experienced in you three things and two others : you are deaf in spite of having ears, dumb in spite of speaking, and blind in spite of having eyes.
You are neither true supporters in combat nor dependable brothers in distress.
Your hands may be soiled with earth.
O examples of those camels whose herdsman has disappeared, if they are collected together from one side they disperse from the other.
By Allāh, I see you in my imagination that if war becomes intense and action is in full swing you would run away from the son of Abī Ṭālib like the woman who becomes naked in the front.
I am certainly on clear guidance from my Lord (Allāh) and on the path of my Prophet and I am on the right path which I adhere to regularly.
